Convert a PNG image to SVG online

Turn a PNG into a vector you can scale

PNG images are made of pixels. ImageToVector traces the visible color regions into SVG shapes, so the result can resize without the pixel grid showing. Upload a PNG, choose a palette and detail level, then download the SVG.

PNG logos and flat-color illustrations are usually the easiest to vectorize. Transparent areas remain transparent. A photograph or textured image becomes a color-reduced interpretation, not a pixel-perfect copy.

How to convert PNG to SVG

Choose your PNG file with the ImageToVector tool. Use fewer colors for a clean logo or icon, and add colors to retain more of the original image. Select a detail level, generate the trace, review it, and download the SVG.

What works well?

Brand marks, icons, badges, simple drawings, and graphics with clear color regions. Very small or blurry images may need manual cleanup after conversion.

What does the SVG contain?

The download is an SVG document made from colored vector paths. It can be opened in a browser or many vector design programs. Review it in your target workflow before production use.
